observations.body: Paul’s hidden struggle seeks rooted and established communities. For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh; rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
